scope: Finite read-only source, AST and ordinary JSON review before packaging/protocol freeze. No installation, imports of candidate/HF/SUP2, execution, arrays/media or historical-science reaudit.

verified_contracts: Only three new runtime/test files are installed with exclusive xb creation. Existing outputs and installation targets are not overwritten; actual partial installation is retained on failure.

Ordered chain is bindings -> three installations -> one six-method unittest invocation -> one audited CLI -> two exact saved input checks -> one PNG and REVIEW -> end bindings/new-source equality -> seal. Any terminal command error raises and stops subsequent functional steps; no retry or cleanup rollback.

All source descriptors, optional pins, template/options/targets and complete native grid plus physical-region declarations are checked before the first singleton preparation. Explicit repo paths and numeric case directories avoid label-based output paths.

The two actual singleton conversions occur once each through unchanged prepare_native_lf_inputs. The adapter then calls existing _preflight once; _preflight reads ordinary JSON only and does not build/evaluate a model.

The output batch uses the exact existing schema/case keys and copies shared options. Every non-geometry task field is checked against the common template; only the two geometry identities are rebound. Future evaluation/index directories are declarations and remain absent.
Failure preserves per-case success/not_pass/not_run and original exception with partial artifacts; ready manifest is reached only after all preparations and the metadata preflight.

Checks compare source-copy bytes, LF four fields to native four masks, derived original160 columns and right8 passive-void-only columns, geometry IDs against old ordinary metadata, full shared grid and all25 task targets. They do not assert cross-location raw descriptor SHA equality.

The single undeformed mm-scale figure shows actual derived solid masks, original80/additional4mm domains, region declarations and the fixed lower-half square. Port arrows describe directions, not measured forces or applied-response results.
CLI audit records NPZ read opens separately from numpy.load calls, including byte-buffer decodes; helper records its own read opens/load calls. These are observations, not universal mechanical hooks.

The finite six tests use mocked singleton preparation and ordinary JSON only. The success case exercises existing pure metadata _preflight, explicit unrelated cwd, exact options/task/path preservation; failure cases cover labels, later source pin, existing sentinel, partial failure and mixed full grid.

Frozen SUP2 run_owned signature supports every supplied argument. Launcher requires its actual same-instance cleanup_verified, F-CPU-CLEAN1/CPU-CLEAN1 and supervisor source SHA. The supervisor uses suspended-root owned Job and a fixed five-second shared cleanup window, including its own TerminateJobObject cleanup; the new launcher adds no process-control fallback.

SUP2 samples supervisor plus all owned Job members under1GiB; this is not an OS hard RSS cap. Helper clock starts before heavy imports; outer launcher clock starts before supervisor import and includes cleanup/receipt read, with180/240 limits.

prepare_execution.py only packages ordinary candidate/source/JSON artifacts and hashes ordinary source. Its NPZ input bindings are declared pins, not NPZ reads; no installation/tests/conversion/plot are invoked there.
remaining_prelaunch_check: After root creates protocol/authorization, compare their actual bindings, candidate mapping, absent fresh outputs/test root and180/240/1GiB parameters against these source bytes. This source review is not protocol execution evidence.

review_operations.scope_basis: Source/AST and ordinary JSON only; no universal dynamic mechanical hooks were installed.
